about: Lyre's test cases: the source of truth for what Qase holds. Edit here, then run Scripts/qase_sync.py push-cases. Each case's `key` is permanent; never reuse one. `automated_by` lists the Xcode tests (Target/Suite/test) that cover the case in whole or in part; a case with no such test is checked by hand.

plans.title: Smoke
plans.description: Twenty minutes, every build that goes to TestFlight: can a user get in, play music and get around?

plans.title: Release Regression
plans.description: Everything, before an App Store release.

plans.title: Connectivity
plans.description: Offline, flaky, cellular-off and server-down behavior.

plans.title: Accessibility
plans.description: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, right-to-left, Reduce Motion, contrast.

plans.title: Foldable (iPhone Duo)
plans.description: Every player closed, open, as a book and in transition.

suites.title: Accessibility & Localization
suites.description: Everyone can use Lyre, in any language and text size.

suites.title: Settings & Persistence
suites.description: What Lyre remembers, upgrades and recovers from.

cases.title: First launch shows the welcome page with no permission prompt
steps: Launch Lyre.
'Welcome to Lyre' and 'Get Started' are shown. There is no Back button.
Wait five seconds without touching anything.
No system permission alert appears.

cases.title: The permissions page explains before iOS asks
cases.preconditions: Fresh install; Media & Apple Music access never answered.
steps: Tap Get Started.
'Before We Ask' explains Media & Apple Music, why Lyre asks and that the library stays private. No system alert yet.
Tap Allow Access.
The system alert appears once.
Tap Allow.
Onboarding continues to the music access result, then Choose Your Player.

cases.title: Declining access still lets the user into Lyre
steps: Tap Get Started, then Not Now.
No system alert. Onboarding goes on to Choose Your Player.
Finish onboarding with any player.
The player opens. Library screens say access is off and how to turn it on, rather than looking broken.

cases.title: Denying the system prompt shows how to turn access on later
steps: Tap Get Started, Allow Access, then Don't Allow in the system alert.
The music access page explains Settings > Privacy & Security > Media & Apple Music, and offers a way on.
Continue through onboarding.
Lyre opens without access and without crashing.

cases.title: Each player's onboarding path ends on that player
steps: Choose Classic and finish.
Meet the wheel, practice, shortcuts, Make It Yours, summary; the click wheel opens.
Reset onboarding; choose Spool and finish.
Meet the Spool tour, design and finish, summary; the Spool opens.
Repeat for Gramophone, Disc and Liquid.
Each shows only its own steps and opens on itself.

cases.title: The Choose Your Player preview never overlaps the text
cases.preconditions: On Choose Your Player, on the smallest supported iPhone and on an iPhone Duo.
steps: Select each of the five players in turn.
Each preview sits between the subtitle and the choices, never over the subtitle (regression: the horn gramophone's bell once covered it).
Read the subtitle.
It says there are five ways to play.

cases.title: An interrupted onboarding resumes where it stopped
steps: Go as far as Meet the Scroll Wheel.
Force-quit Lyre and open it again.
Onboarding opens on Meet the Scroll Wheel, not the welcome page.
Tap Back repeatedly.
Each step goes back one, to the welcome page.

cases.title: Classic customization is one choice per step and can be skipped
cases.preconditions: Classic chosen; at Make It Yours.
steps: Tap Keep the Classic Look.
Goes straight to You're All Set!
Go back and tap Customize.
Body, color, highlight, screen size, wheel feel and screen timeout follow, one per step, each with a live preview.
Skip practice on Give It a Try.
Continue stays disabled until the lesson is done; Skip Practice moves on.

cases.title: A library of on-device music loads into every list
cases.preconditions: Access granted; device has synced music, albums, playlists and podcasts.
steps: Open Songs, Albums, Artists and Playlists.
Each lists the device's library, filed A–Z ignoring leading 'The', 'A', 'An'.
Open an album, an artist and a playlist.
Each shows its own songs in order.

cases.title: An Apple Music subscriber's cloud library loads alongside local music
cases.preconditions: Signed in with an active Apple Music subscription and a cloud library.
steps: Launch Lyre.
Cloud albums and playlists appear with artwork; on-device songs are not duplicated.
Play a cloud-only song.
It streams and plays.

cases.title: A second launch shows the cached library at once
cases.preconditions: Lyre has loaded the library at least once.
steps: Force-quit and relaunch Lyre in airplane mode.
Lists are populated immediately from the cache (no artwork yet is acceptable).
Turn airplane mode off.
The live library replaces the cached one without the list jumping.

cases.title: An empty library says so instead of looking broken
cases.preconditions: Access granted on a device with no music and no podcasts.
steps: Open Songs, Albums, Artists and Playlists in each player.
Each shows its empty message (e.g. 'No songs in library', 'No albums in your library').
Open Podcasts › Search Podcasts, type something, and wait 30 seconds.
Any 'Something Went Wrong' alert shows over the sheet; after Dismiss the sheet and what was typed are still there (LYRE-2).

cases.title: Revoked access is explained and recovers when restored
steps: In Settings > Privacy & Security > Media & Apple Music, turn Lyre off. Return to Lyre.
'Media & Apple Music Access Needed' with Open Settings and Not Now.
Tap Not Now.
The player opens; the prompt doesn't force its way back on next launch.
Turn access back on and return.
'Access Restored — Reloading your library…' then the player with the library back.

cases.title: Music added in the Music app appears on return
cases.preconditions: Lyre open with a loaded library.
steps: Add an album to the library in the Music app, then return to Lyre.
The album appears without relaunching.

cases.title: A very large library stays responsive
steps: Launch Lyre cold.
Interface responds within two seconds; no freeze while loading.
Scroll Songs fast, and scrub the A–Z index in each player.
Scrolling is smooth; the index jumps straight to each letter.

cases.title: Play, pause, next and previous work in every player
cases.preconditions: Library with an album of 3+ songs.
steps: Play the album's first song.
It plays; Now Playing shows title, artist and album.
Next, then Previous within three seconds.
Goes to song 2, then back to song 1.
Previous more than three seconds into a song.
Restarts the song instead of going back.
Repeat in Classic, Spool, Gramophone, Disc and Liquid.
Same behavior in every player.

cases.title: Play Next and Add to Queue say the same thing in every player
steps: Queue a song with Play Next.
Message 'Playing next: <song>'; it plays after the current song.
Queue an album with Add to Queue.
'Queued: <album>'; its songs go to the bottom of Up Next in order, each once.
Queue an album where some songs are unavailable.
Message says how many of how many were added.

cases.title: Up Next can be reordered, trimmed and cleared
steps: Move a song in Up Next.
Order changes and playback follows the new order.
Remove a song.
It's gone; the current song keeps playing.
Clear Up Next.
A confirmation is asked first; after it, only the current song remains.

cases.title: Starting an album over a hand-built queue asks first
cases.preconditions: Up Next built by hand with Play Next / Add to Queue.
steps: Start playing a different album.
Lyre asks before replacing the queue.
Cancel.
The hand-built queue is untouched.

cases.title: Shuffle and repeat cycle and stick
steps: Toggle repeat three times.
Off → All → One → Off.
Toggle shuffle.
Songs play in a shuffled order; turning it off restores album order.
Shake the phone with Hold off (Classic).
Shuffles. With Hold on, or in the Spool, shaking does nothing.

cases.title: Songs can't be queued while a podcast plays
steps: Try Play Next on a song.
Message: 'Songs can't be queued while a podcast plays'. The episode keeps playing.

cases.title: Switching players keeps what's playing
cases.preconditions: A song playing in any player.
steps: Switch to each other player in Settings.
The hand-over plays; the same song keeps playing at the same place in the new player.

cases.title: The wheel scrolls menus and the center button selects
steps: Spin the wheel clockwise and counter-clockwise.
Highlight moves down and up one item per click, with a click sound and tick.
Press the center.
Opens the highlighted item. MENU goes back.
Spin fast down Songs.
Scrolling speeds up with spin speed.

cases.title: The Hold switch locks the controls
steps: Long-press the Hold switch.
It shows enabled; the wheel and buttons do nothing.
Long-press again.
Controls work again.

cases.title: Now Playing shows progress, scrubbing and nothing-playing
steps: Open Now Playing with nothing played.
'Nothing playing'.
Play a song and open Now Playing.
Title, artist, elapsed and remaining time advance each second.
Press the center to scrub, spin, press again.
Playback jumps to the scrubbed time.

cases.title: Search lowers the wheel while typing and finds the library
steps: Open Search and type an artist's name.
The wheel lowers out of the way; results list artists, then albums, then songs.
Type 'zzzz'.
'No Results'.
Press the keyboard's Search key.
The keyboard goes and the wheel returns.

cases.title: Themes, highlight, screen size, clicks and backlight apply at once
steps: Change body/finish, highlight color, screen size, scroll sensitivity, click sound and backlight timeout.
Each change shows immediately.
Leave the player idle past the backlight timeout.
The screen dims; touching the wheel lights it.
Force-quit and relaunch.
Every choice is kept.

cases.title: The battery indicator is honest
steps: Check the battery icon at 100%, 50%, under 20% unplugged, and charging.
Icon matches the level; red only when under 20% and unplugged; bolt when charging.
Run on a Mac (Designed for iPad) or the simulator.
No red low-battery warning when the level can't be read.

cases.title: Turning the phone opens the Artwork Carousel
cases.preconditions: Classic player with albums that have artwork.
steps: Turn the phone to landscape.
The Artwork Carousel opens on the albums.
Open an album's gatefold and use its controls.
Each control responds; long-pressing the closed cover queues the record.
Turn upright.
Back to the wheel.

cases.title: A tape swiped into the deck loads and plays
steps: Open the deck door; find a tape in the rack.
The rack opens with the tape at the front named in the header.
Swipe the tape left.
It loads, the deck closes and the album plays; reels turn at tape speed.
Swipe a tape right instead.
It's queued, not played.

cases.title: The rack's index, flicks and search find a tape
steps: Run a finger down the A–Z index.
A bold letter shows beside the finger; the first tape under each letter comes forward.
Flick the rack.
It coasts past several tapes.
Search for an album.
The rack narrows to matching tapes.
Close and reopen the rack.
It reopens on the tape last at the front.

cases.title: Cases, mixtapes, singles and the podcast shelf
cases.preconditions: Library with albums, singles, playlists and podcasts.
steps: Tap a cased album.
Its case opens on the J-card; dragging the lid down folds it shut.
Look at a single.
Labelled as a single.
Open the mixtape shelf.
Playlists as mixtapes, songs split into sides A and B.
Open the podcast shelf.
Shows as spoken-word tapes, episodes newest first.

cases.title: The owner's manual, Slim design and finishes
steps: Open the owner's manual.
The tutorial steps through each lesson.
Pick the Slim design and another finish.
The deck changes straight away.

cases.title: A record from a sleeve plays when the needle drops
steps: Open the crate, pick an album, choose a song from its sleeve.
The record goes on the turntable and that song plays.
Drag the tonearm to another band.
Playback jumps to the song under the needle.
Lift the arm off the record.
It returns to its rest and playback stops.

cases.title: The crank, the play switch and the Up Next bin
steps: Press play with no record on.
The switch springs back.
Wind the crank a full turn.
All songs shuffle.
Open the Up Next bin; flip, remove, reorder and play.
Each works as on the other players.

cases.title: Horn and cabinet designs, the booklet and the drawer index
steps: Switch between Horn and Cabinet in the booklet.
The machine changes; the booklet shows the version and a tutorial.
Run a finger along the drawer's index.
A bold letter shows above the finger; records jump by letter.

cases.title: A song from a case puts the disc on and shuts the lid
steps: Open the lid, pick a case, choose a song.
The disc goes on, the lid shuts, the song plays; the display shows it.
Tap the lid again.
Backs out.
Press MODE repeatedly.
Steps through repeat modes, shown on the display.

cases.title: Instructions, finishes and the booklet
steps: Open the instructions.
A tutorial; picking a finish applies at once.
Open a jewel case's booklet.
Shows the album's songs.

cases.title: Now Playing waves change songs and rest away
cases.preconditions: Liquid player with a song playing in the middle of an album.
steps: Swipe the forward and back waves.
Next and previous song; the first song has no back wave.
Leave it idle.
The waves rest away; a touch brings them back.
Tap the cover.
Waves go away and come back.
Tap the song's name.
Its album opens.

cases.title: Library: lists, card stack, search and Up Next
steps: Open the library menu, then Songs, Recently Played and Recently Added.
Each opens; each list keeps its own layout (list or stack).
Flip through the card stack; open a cover.
It swings open onto its album; the stack reopens on that cover later.
Pull Up Next up from the bottom.
It rises like a sheet; dragging down puts it away.
Search for an album.
It's found.

cases.title: The A–Z index shows the letter under the finger, in order
cases.preconditions: Liquid Songs in stack and list layouts, with titles starting with accented letters, digits and non-Latin scripts.
steps: Read the index.
'#' first, then A–Z, then other scripts; 'Á' and 'È' are filed under A and E, not separate.
Run a finger along the stack's index row.
The letter shows large and bold on a disc above the finger, and the stack jumps to it with a tick per letter.
Run a finger down the list's index strip.
The letter shows beside the finger, to its left.
Lift the finger.
The disc fades.

cases.title: Settings, tutorial and the visualizer
steps: Open Settings.
The tutorial, playback options and the other players are offered.
Open the tutorial and swipe.
One lesson at a time.
Start the visualizer, then touch the screen.
The visualizer gives way to the controls.

cases.title: Find a show by name and subscribe
steps: Type a show's name.
Results show title, author and artwork; shows without a public feed aren't listed.
Tap Subscribe.
A spinner, then a green tick; the show appears under Subscribed with its episode count.
Swipe the subscription left and delete.
Unsubscribed; its downloads are removed.

cases.title: Subscribe by pasting a feed address
cases.preconditions: Online; a public RSS feed URL on the clipboard.
steps: Paste the URL into the search field.
'Subscribe to this feed' with the address underneath.
Tap it.
Subscribed. A feed that has moved (redirect) still works.
Paste a web page that isn't a feed.
'Couldn't Subscribe — That address isn't a podcast feed.'

cases.title: Streaming an episode resumes where it was left
steps: Play an episode for two minutes, then play something else.
Play the episode again.
It picks up near where it stopped. Back skips 15s, forward 30s, inside the episode.
Change speed to 1.5×.
Voice keeps its pitch; the speed is kept next time.
Let it play to within 30s of the end.
Marked played (tick); a half-heard episode shows a half circle.

cases.title: Downloads: save, play offline, remove
steps: Swipe right on an episode to download.
Progress shows; the episode moves to Downloaded when finished.
Turn on airplane mode and play it.
Plays from the device.
Swipe again to remove; Remove All Downloads.
Removed; the space used drops to zero.
Background Lyre mid-download for five minutes.
The download completes anyway.

cases.title: Auto-download new episodes waits for Wi‑Fi
cases.preconditions: Auto-download New Episodes on; on cellular only.
steps: Wait for a subscribed show to publish an episode (or refresh after one has).
No cellular data is used for it.
Join Wi‑Fi.
At most three new episodes per show download.
Turn on Remove After Playing and finish one.
Its download is removed.

cases.title: Import and export subscriptions as OPML
cases.preconditions: An OPML export from another podcast app in Files.
steps: Import OPML… and pick the file.
'Added N podcasts' (with how many feeds couldn't be read, if any). Already-subscribed shows aren't duplicated.
Pick a file that isn't OPML.
'No podcast feeds were found in that file.'
Export OPML… and re-import into another app.
The same shows come across.

cases.title: On-device and streamed copies of a show merge
cases.preconditions: A show both synced to the device from Apple Podcasts and subscribed in Lyre.
steps: Open the show in each player.
One show, each episode once, newest first; the downloaded copy wins.
Finish an episode in Apple Podcasts, then look in Lyre.
Marked played in Lyre too.

cases.title: Podcast search offline says to check the connection
steps: Search Podcasts for any name.
'Search isn't available right now. Check your connection and try again.' — not 'No podcasts found'.
Turn airplane mode off and search again.
Results appear.

cases.title: Subscribing offline fails clearly and can be retried
steps: Paste a feed URL and tap Subscribe to this feed.
'Couldn't Subscribe' with the reason; nothing is added.
Go back online and tap it again.
Subscribes.

cases.title: Subscribed shows stay listed offline with their last episodes
cases.preconditions: Subscribed to two shows; then airplane mode on.
steps: Force-quit and relaunch; open Podcasts.
Both shows and their episode lists are there.
Pull to refresh / revisit Podcasts.
Nothing disappears; no error replaces the list.

cases.title: Streaming an episode offline says to download for offline
cases.preconditions: Subscribed show with a not-downloaded episode; airplane mode on.
steps: Play the episode.
Banner: 'You're offline. Download episodes to listen without a connection.' Playback stops cleanly.
Play a downloaded episode.
Plays.

cases.title: Cellular data off for Lyre reads as offline, not a server fault
cases.preconditions: Wi‑Fi off; Settings > Cellular > Lyre off.
steps: Launch Lyre as an Apple Music subscriber with no downloaded music.
Any library error says 'No Internet Connection', not 'Service Unavailable'.
Search Podcasts.
The connection message from NET-01.

cases.title: A connection lost mid-stream or mid-download recovers
cases.preconditions: Streaming an episode; a download in progress.
steps: Turn airplane mode on for 20 seconds, then off.
The stream either rides out the gap from its buffer or reports offline; it never hangs silently.
Check the download.
It resumes or goes back to not downloaded; it never claims to be downloaded when it isn't.

cases.title: A slow or captive-portal network doesn't freeze Lyre
cases.preconditions: Network Link Conditioner set to '100% Loss' then 'Very Bad Network'; or a hotel Wi‑Fi sign-in page.
steps: Launch Lyre and use the player.
The interface stays responsive; library on-device music plays.
Search Podcasts.
Fails within ~30s with the connection message; a sign-in page is never shown as results.

cases.title: The podcast directory or a feed server being down
cases.preconditions: Simulated with the -UITestNetwork serverError launch argument (debug builds).
steps: Search Podcasts.
'Search isn't available right now…', not 'No podcasts found'.
Refresh subscriptions.
Last copies kept.

cases.title: Lock screen, Control Center and headphone controls
cases.preconditions: A song playing, then a podcast episode streaming.
steps: Lock the phone; use play/pause, next, previous.
Each works; artwork and title shown.
Stream an episode; use the lock screen's skip buttons and scrubber.
Back 15s, forward 30s, scrubbing seeks.
Use wired/AirPods play-pause.
Toggles playback.

cases.title: AirPlay to a speaker or TV
cases.preconditions: An AirPlay device on the same network.
steps: Tap the AirPlay button in any player.
The system picker lists the device.
Pick it.
Audio moves; the player names the device.
Switch back to iPhone.
Audio returns.

cases.title: Calls, Siri and other apps interrupt and resume
cases.preconditions: A song playing; then repeat with a podcast streaming.
steps: Receive a phone call; decline after ten seconds.
Playback pauses for the call and resumes after.
Ask Siri something.
Ducks or pauses, then resumes.
Play a video in another app.
Lyre pauses and doesn't fight for audio.

cases.title: Headphones unplugged or AirPods taken out pause playback
steps: Unplug / remove the AirPods.
Playback pauses rather than coming out of the speaker.

cases.title: Background, return and relaunch keep the user's place
cases.preconditions: Any player, somewhere inside a list.
steps: Go to the Home Screen for a minute, then return.
Same screen, same place; music kept playing.
Force-quit and relaunch.
The chosen player opens; onboarding doesn't run again.

cases.title: Low Power Mode and thermal state
steps: Use each player for five minutes.
Animations simplify; playback is unaffected; no stutter.

cases.title: Cold launch time
cases.preconditions: Release build on the oldest supported device.
steps: Force-quit and launch five times.
The first screen appears in under 1.5s each time.

cases.title: Each player's open layout
steps: Open the Duo with the Spool.
Deck beside the rack; a swiped tape waits in the deck and plays when the phone closes.
Open it with the Gramophone, partway and flat, in portrait.
The machine above; below, a search field, the dividers and the covers in a row to swipe through. Tapping the middle cover opens its sleeve (LYRE-13). A phone that doesn't fold has none.
Turn the open Duo on its side.
Just the Gramophone, bigger: no covers below.
Open it with the Disc.
It's a Discman.
Open it with Liquid, flat and held as a book.
The pool under the waves; as a book, the library beside them.
Open it with Classic.
The Artwork Carousel.

cases.title: Folding and unfolding mid-task loses nothing
steps: In each player, fold and unfold repeatedly while a sheet, a case or a search is open.
Playback continues; no crash; whatever was open comes back or closes cleanly.
Fold mid-onboarding.
Onboarding keeps its step.

cases.title: Unfolding into the Artwork Carousel offers no Back: closing the phone goes back
cases.preconditions: iPhone Duo, Classic player (then Liquid), closed, on any screen.
steps: Open the Duo partway, then fully, in portrait and in landscape.
The Artwork Carousel opens. Top left reads "Close iPhone to go back"; there is no Back button.
Open an album's gatefold.
Its own back button ("‹ Albums") shows and closes the album back to the covers.
Close the Duo.
Back on the wheel, at Now Playing.
On an iPhone that doesn't fold, turn it sideways.
The carousel shows "‹ Back", which turns it upright again.

cases.title: VoiceOver can use every player
steps: Classic: swipe up/down on the wheel.
It's adjustable; the highlighted item is read out.
Onboarding: move through each page.
Every control has a name; the step ('Step 3 of 14') is readable.
Each player: find and activate play, next, the library and settings.
All reachable and named; decorative parts are skipped.
Any A–Z index.
Adjustable; swipes move letter by letter.

cases.title: Largest accessibility text size
cases.preconditions: Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Larger Text at maximum.
steps: Go through onboarding.
Every choice and Continue can be reached by scrolling; nothing is cut off.
Use the main menu and Podcasts search.
Usable; text wraps rather than truncating meaning.

cases.title: Right-to-left languages
cases.preconditions: Device language Arabic or Hebrew (or Xcode's Right-to-Left pseudolanguage).
steps: Go through onboarding and open each player.
Layout mirrors where it should; the wheel and transport controls keep their physical layout; nothing overlaps.

cases.title: Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast and Bold Text
steps: Reduce Motion: switch players, open the Liquid menu and the carousel.
Big motions become fades; nothing spins endlessly.
Increase Contrast and Bold Text: read each player's text.
Readable; nothing disappears into its background.

cases.title: Landscape and rotation
steps: Start onboarding in landscape and finish it.
Every step reachable.
Rotate during onboarding.
The step is kept.

cases.title: Names in any script sort and index sensibly
cases.preconditions: Library with artists in Latin with accents, Japanese, Arabic, and names starting with digits or emoji.
steps: Open Artists and Songs in each player.
Digits and emoji file under #; accented names with their letter; other scripts under their own letter, after Z.

cases.title: An upgrade from 1.x keeps the chosen finish
cases.preconditions: A 1.x build installed with a finish such as 'Classic Black' chosen.
steps: Install the current build over it.
The same finish (now 'Onyx') is shown; onboarding doesn't rerun.

cases.title: Damaged saved data is recovered from
steps: Corrupt the library cache and the subscriptions file (Devices window > download container, edit, replace).
Launch Lyre.
No crash. The cache is rebuilt; settings fall back to defaults where unreadable.

cases.title: Low storage
steps: Download a long episode.
Fails cleanly (back to not downloaded); no half file is listed as downloaded.
Relaunch.
Lyre opens; settings and subscriptions intact.
